design_quote: After exclusion of 446 ineligible studies, five randomised and two prospective trials involving 468 participants with either osteoarthritis or rheumatoid arthritis were included.
k_quote: five randomised and two prospective trials involving 468 participants
reason: Pooled analyses mix randomised and non-randomised prospective trials; an RCT-only subgroup was only planned a priori, not reported.
